title: PotionLimits
description: This plugin will allow players to disable or block effects.
body:
# PotionLimiter

**A lightweight, configurable Paper plugin that gives server owners complete control over potion effects.**

PotionLimiter is designed for SMPs, PvP servers, and survival communities that want to balance gameplay by restricting overpowered potion effects without removing potions entirely.

## Features

* Configure maximum amplifier levels for every potion effect
* Disable specific potion effects completely
* Automatically downgrade effects that exceed your configured limits
* Prevent players from keeping illegal potion effects
* Configurable messages
* Lightweight and optimized for performance
* Simple YAML configuration
* Built specifically for modern Paper servers

## Why use PotionLimiter?

Potion effects can quickly become overpowered on competitive or long-term survival servers. PotionLimiter lets you keep potions in the game while ensuring they stay balanced.

Examples include:

* Limit Speed to Speed I
* Disable Strength entirely
* Prevent Haste above Haste II
* Block custom or unintended potion effects
* Create balanced progression for your server

## Configuration

Everything is configurable through easy-to-edit YAML files.

You can:

* Set maximum levels for each potion effect
* Enable or disable individual effects
* Customize player messages
* Reload the configuration without restarting the server

## Designed For

* SMPs
* Lifesteal servers
* PvP servers
* Economy servers
* Adventure servers
* Custom progression servers

## Compatibility

* Paper
* Modern Minecraft versions (26.1.2)

## Performance

PotionLimiter is designed to be lightweight with minimal performance impact, making it suitable for both small private servers and large public communities.

## Support

If you encounter bugs or have feature suggestions, please open an issue on the project's repository.

Thank you for using PotionLimiter!

Project made with assistance of ChatGPT.
